description: Points www at Clarity website hosting and adds the hostname ownership check and the two certificate checks that Clarity's hosting (Cloudflare for SaaS) needs. Changes only www, _cf-custom-hostname.www and _acme-challenge.www under the applied domain; mail and apex records are not touched.
variableDescription: cfhv: hostname ownership token issued by Cloudflare for SaaS (a UUID). acme1, acme2: the two ACME DNS-01 certificate validation values for www (43-character base64url each).
